subject: Update after earlier reply
text: The venue change has added three days to the renovation. I know you need a firm date by Friday, so I am sending this update right after your earlier reply. The new contractor cannot start until Monday, and the first coat of paint needs four drying hours between sessions. I have asked for a revised timeline and will forward it tomorrow morning. In the meantime, please keep the members' notices paused so we do not announce a completion we may miss. I will call if anything changes. Please confirm whether that revised start still works for you.
